title: British Creamy Lemon Trifle
description: A classic British dessert with layers of creamy sponge cake, lemon syrup, and whipped cream, finished with a sprinkle of citrus zest.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and flour a 9-inch (23cm) round cake pan.
Sift flour, sugar, and baking powder into a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, butter, and vanilla extract until light and fluffy.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from oven and let cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.
To make the lemon syrup, combine lemon juice and sugar in a small saucepan.
Heat over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
To assemble the trifle, cut the cooled cake into 1-inch (2.5cm) cubes.
In a large bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Add the unsalted butter and whip until combined.
Fold in the lemon zest and vanilla extract.
Place a layer of cake cubes in the bottom of a large serving dish.
Pour half of the lemon syrup over the cake.
Top with half of the whipped cream mixture.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of whipped cream on top.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.
